official_title: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts – Second Presidency compromise text

institution_roles.evidence_locator: PDF p. 1 From Presidency to Delegations; introduction paragraphs 3-6 attribute substantive preparation to the Czech Presidency. The Council association represents the Presidency acting within the Council, without implying Council adoption.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Second formally published Council Presidency compromise.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The Czech Presidency, acting within the Council, is the substantive drafter and originator, and Delegations are the recipient. The Council author association represents that Presidency origin and does not imply Council adoption. The document is the second non-binding Presidency compromise and names ST 10069/22 as the previous document; the 20 July working-party meeting is not a publication date. The issue date remains 15 July 2022. Annex 6 of ST 15322/24 documents later disclosure on 28 October 2024, not first-ever publication.

document_date.locator: PDF p. 1 cover: Brussels, 15 July 2022; ST 11124/22.
document_date.meaning: The official PDF establishes the issue date of this exact second-compromise note.

publication_date.locator: Annex 6 reply dated 28 October 2024; PDF p. 9 lists ST 11124/22 and p. 11 states that all listed documents are available in the public register and enclosed.
publication_date.meaning: The Council reply establishes documented later disclosure/public access on 2024-10-28, not first-ever publication.
